ios.desc:
Welcome to Single Day, where every day is a chance to shine as today’s unique you! Embrace the moment with a journal that’s more than just a diary - it’s a time-traveling adventure to connect with every version of yourself. 

Write to your 5-year-old self, inspire your future you, or send strength to a past you who needs it. With Single Day, you live one day at a time, crafting a story that’s singularly yours.

Why Single Day?
- Post as Today’s You: Capture your thoughts, dreams, or goals in a daily journal that celebrates the present. Each day’s you is unique - make it count!
- Letters Across Time: Visit profiles of your past or future selves to post messages or advice. Encourage your younger self or share hopes with the you of tomorrow.
- Your Story, One Day: Build a deeper connection with yourself through authentic, heartfelt entries, all wrapped in a clean, minimalist design.
